Title / Goal / Input
* Please change "CodinGame" to another name, as CodinGame doesn't determine a player's level in the manner described in the statement.

Goal
* Please revise "the number of times its xp exceeds 500", as its meaning is unclear.

* Please format 500 as a {{constant}}.

Input
* Line 1: Please add "An integer" before "N".

* Next N lines: Please add "An integer" before "xp".

Input/Stub generator
* Please use a consistent variable name: either N or nbAccounts.

Output
* Please delete "First".

* Please specify the required output {{Level}}.

Constraints
* Please format "N" as a [[variable]], as mentioned by @kozuechan.

* Please use a more appropriate upper bound of [[N]], as mentioned by @kozuechan.

* Please add a constraint on [[xp]], as mentioned by @kozuechan.

Cases
* These cases are the same:
  • Examples (Test 1)
  • Examples (Validator 1)

* Newbies (Test 2): Please remove the trailing newline from the input.

* Random values (Test 4) and Randomness (Validator 4): Please use *similar* values of [[xp]].

Thanks.

## General

- The actual formula for calculating levels in CodinGame is more complex. Mentioning CodinGame may be misleading.

## Constraints

- Please format N as a variable [[N]].
- Please set the upper bound of N to 10. The current upper bound is too large compared to the values actually used in the test cases.
- Please specify the lower and upper bounds of xp. As with N, base them on the values actually used in the test cases.

Thank you.

Below are my comments on the updated contribution:

Goal
* Please replace the sentence "Here, … 500 ()." with the following:

An account starts at Level {{0}}. It gains one level for every {{500}} XP it accumulates.

Output
* Please change "calculted with" to "based on".

Constraints
* Please change 100000 to 10⁶.

Cases
* These cases are the same:
  • Examples (Test 1)
  • Examples (Validator 1)

  Please revise them so that they use similar XP values rather than exactly the same ones.

* Newbies (Test 2):

  • Please remove the trailing newline from the input.

  • Please change 100 to 0.

* Newbies 2 (Validator 2):

  • Please change 700 to 500.

* All levels (Test 3):

  • Please change 1 to another one-digit number.

  • Please change 2600 to a 4-digit number which is divisible by 500.

* Newbies and Elders (Validator 3):

  • Please change 1 to another one-digit number.

  • Please change 700 to a 4-digit number that leaves a remainder of 499 when divided by 500.

* Random values (Test 4):

  • Please change 513 to a 5-digit number less than 50,000 that leaves a remainder of 499 when divided by 500.

Thanks.
